title: Patch: buying a chase asks first, since one press spends the whole Chase Shard bar
thread:
**Issue #2683 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2683: Patch: buying a chase asks first, since one press spends the whole Chase Shard bar
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
After ten cosmetic packs the Chase Shard bar is full, and the shop lists the Legendary and Mythic cosmetics it can buy. Each has a Buy button that spends the whole bar on its first press, with no question, so a slip on the wrong row costs ten packs' worth of progress and cannot be undone. Spending a single card token or cosmetic token already asks first (“Unlock Galaxy? This spends 1 Epic token.”). Once built, a chase asks the same way, “Buy Galaxy? This spends your full Chase Shard bar.”, with Confirm and Cancel. The panel's Open and Buy buttons also wait while another purchase on the same page is still being answered, as the rest of the shop does.

## Why
- `apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx:417-427`: a chase's Buy calls `onChase`, which posts `buyChase` at once (`:168-185`) and empties the bar (`CHASE_SHARD_PACKS` packs, §14.6).
- R2480000 (issue #2537) made the cosmetic token offer ask first, “as the shop's card token does” (`apps/web/src/collection/TokenOffer.tsx:118-187`, `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx:206-238`), on Hearthstone's semantics that the shop asks before a spend it cannot take back. The chase is the costliest spend in the cosmetic economy and the only one left that does not ask.
- §14.11 and R2378000: the client holds its Buy and Open buttons while one of its spends is out. The Shop's Buy (`apps/web/src/shop/Shop.tsx:83`, `:119`) and the card pack screen (`apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`) do it through `useSpendOut`/`spendOutNow` (`apps/web/src/net/spending.ts`). `CosmeticPacks.tsx`, on the same `/shop` page, uses neither for its Open or its chase Buy.

## Proposal
- In the Chase Shard panel (`ShardBar`), the first press on a chase's Buy asks in the row's place, as `TokenOffer` does: an inline alert dialog naming the cosmetic in the reader's language and the bar it spends, Confirm and Cancel, the focus on Cancel as it opens, and Escape answering Cancel. Confirm sends `buyChase` once, and Cancel spends nothing and puts the focus back on the Buy button.
- Hold the panel's Open and chase Buy while `useSpendOut()` reports a spend out, and check `spendOutNow()` in their handlers, as `Shop.tsx` does.
- A new ruling (the lowest free number in this issue's block), as R2480000 was for the token offer, with Hearthstone semantics; rejected alternatives to record: asking only for a Mythic chase, and an undo, which the server's ledger cannot take back.
- One new string in `apps/web/src/i18n` (zh-CN) for the question.

## Where it lands
- `apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`; tests in `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx` (which already drives the panel)
- `apps/web/src/i18n/` (the question's translation)
- `spec/rulings/R<n>.md`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; SPEC §14.6, §14.11

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A first press on a chase's Buy sends nothing and shows the question with the cosmetic's name; Cancel sends nothing and returns the focus to Buy; Escape answers Cancel.
- [ ] Confirm sends exactly one `buyChase` and the panel shows the emptied bar as today.
- [ ] While another spend on the page is out, the panel's Open and chase Buy are held and send nothing.
- [ ] The tests are named after the new ruling and listed in its `proven_in`; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/shop/Shop.test.tsx`, typecheck and eslint pass.

## Size and risks
Small to medium: about 40 lines in one component, one string, one ruling and tests. Client only; the server already runs each spend once (R2124000). Risk: an e2e spec that buys a chase in one press needs its extra Confirm click; grep `e2e/` for the chase test id.

## Plan

_Written by `gpt` (codex, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41320556408)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.**

Make a Chase Shard purchase ask for confirmation before it spends the full bar: the inline alert dialog names the chosen cosmetic, focuses Cancel, treats Escape as Cancel, returns focus to Buy, and sends exactly one purchase only on Confirm. Make the cosmetic-pack panel's Open and chase Buy controls participate in the tab-wide spend wait, including handler-time guards, and document both decisions in SPEC §14.6, §14.11 and new ruling R2683000.

**Files to touch.**

| Path | Status | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx` | change | Add the inline chase confirmation state/focus/Escape flow and apply `useSpendOut()`/`spendOutNow()` to cosmetic-pack Open and chase Buy/Confirm. |
| `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx` | change | Add R2683000 confirmation, focus, single-send and shared-spend-wait coverage; update the existing one-click chase purchase test to Confirm. |
| `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | Translate `Buy {name}? This spends your full Chase Shard bar.`. |
| `apps/web/README.md` | change | Keep the shop and `net/spending.ts` contract entries current with the inline chase confirmation and held cosmetic Open/Buy controls. |
| `spec/14-economy.md` | change | In §14.6 specify the chase confirmation; in §14.11 name the cosmetic panel's Open and chase Buy among held spend controls. |
| `spec/rulings/R2683000.md` | new | Record the confirmation and spend-wait ruling, Hearthstone semantics, rejected alternatives, and `Shop.test.tsx` evidence. |
| `spec/pending/2683.md` | new | Add R2683000's pending §11 provenance paragraph. |

Do not touch any crate under `crates/`, any app other than `apps/web`, or any `apps/web` file not listed above; in particular, do not change generated wire files, CSS, e2e specs, manifests/lockfiles, `SPEC.md`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, or forbidden bot/workflow paths. Governing text: SPEC §14.6 and §14.11; R1306002 (the bar), R2124000 (one send per press), R2378000 (one spend out), and R2480000 (the existing inline irreversible-spend confirmation pattern).

**Steps.**

1. In `apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`, update the file header to cite R2683000's confirmation and same-tab hold. Extend the React imports with `useId` and `KeyboardEvent`, import `../economy/spend.css` plus `spendOutNow`/`useSpendOut`, call `useSpendOut()` once in `CosmeticPacks`, pass it to `ShardBar`, and add `spendOutNow()` to both `open` and `chase` handler guards. Give Open `className="spend-wait"`, disable it for local busy or `spendOut`, and set `aria-busy={spendOut}` so its own and another panel's spend show the existing wheel.
2. In `ShardBar`, accept `spendOut: boolean`; add `asking: string | null`, `asked: string | null`, and one `useId()` label id. Add an ask helper that checks `busy`, the rendered `spendOut`, and `spendOutNow()` before setting both ids; add Cancel by clearing `asking`, and stop propagation plus Cancel on Escape. For the selected cosmetic, render a `.token-confirm` `role="alertdialog"` in place of its `.token-row`, labeled by `t("Buy {name}? This spends your full Chase Shard bar.", { name: t(cosmetic.name) })`, then Confirm and Cancel in `.token-confirm__actions`; Cancel has `autoFocus`, while Confirm has `disabled={busy !== null || spendOut}` and its handler must also recheck `busy`, `spendOut`, and `spendOutNow()` before it clears the question and calls `onChase` once with the same resolved `cardId`. For an ordinary row, keep the existing preview/card selector, but make Buy a `spend-wait`, use `disabled={busy !== null || asking !== null || spendOut || (fits !== null && chosen === undefined)}`, set `aria-busy={spendOut && (fits === null || chosen !== undefined)}`, set `autoFocus={asked === cosmetic.id}` for focus restoration, and make its click only call the ask helper (never `onChase`). Preserve the existing `Buying…` state after Confirm.
3. In `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, add the exact key `Buy {name}? This spends your full Chase Shard bar.` beside the cosmetic-pack strings with value `购买{name}？这将消耗整个追猎碎片进度条。`.
4. In `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx`'s existing `describe("#1667 the Chase Shard bar", ...)`, keep using `AURORA`, `cosmeticPacksFull()`, the stub server and Testing Library role queries rather than adding production test IDs. Add `it("R2683000 the first Buy asks in the row, in the reader's language, with Cancel focused, and sends nothing", ...)`; set zh-CN, pass `{ ...AURORA, name: "Cracked ice" }`, and assert the accessible dialog name is `购买碎冰？这将消耗整个追猎碎片进度条。`, the Buy is absent, Cancel has focus, and no chase POST was sent. Add `it("R2683000 Cancel and Escape spend nothing and return focus to Buy", ...)`, exercising both answers and asserting zero chase POSTs. Rename the existing `a chase bought empties...` test to `R2683000 Confirm sends exactly one chase purchase, empties the bar, and takes the choice with it`; after the initial Buy assert zero POSTs and the dialog text `Buy Aurora table? This spends your full Chase Shard bar.`, click its Confirm once, then retain its exact request-body, empty/resting bar and removed-choice assertions and assert the endpoint was called once.
5. In the existing shared-spend section of `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx`, add `it("R2683000 cosmetic Open and chase Buy wait while another spend is out and send nothing", ...)`: make `cosmeticServer` answer `cosmeticPacksFull()`, render the shipped registry, start `spendOutside()`, and use `T.open` plus `T.chasePick("table-astral")`. Assert both are disabled, `aria-busy="true"`, and `spend-wait`, click both and assert zero open/chase POSTs, then settle the outside spend and assert they re-enable. This proves both reactive disabling and the handlers' no-send behavior.
6. In `apps/web/README.md`, update the `net/spending.ts` architecture row to include the cosmetic-pack panel's Open and chase Buy among same-tab held controls, and update the `shop/` row so the Chase Shard choice asks inline before its POST. Do not broaden the client into deciding eligibility or price.
7. In `spec/14-economy.md` §14.6, add that the first chase Buy press shows the exact localized inline question, Confirm buys once, and Cancel/Escape spend nothing and restore focus, citing `[[R2683000]]`. In §14.11, make the client-held list explicitly include the cosmetic-pack panel's Open and Chase Shard Buy while any tab spend is out, also citing `[[R2683000]]`, without changing the server's authority or queue semantics.
8. Create `spec/rulings/R2683000.md` with front matter `id: R2683000`, title `"Buying a chase asks before spending the full Chase Shard bar, and the cosmetic-pack panel waits on another spend (issue #2683)"`, `cards: "§14.6, §14.11; R1306002, R2124000, R2378000, R2480000, issue #2683"`, and a `proven_in` list containing `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx`. State the exact dialog/keyboard/focus/single-POST behavior and the Open/Buy spend hold; identify it as client presentation under CLAUDE.md rule 7, follow Hearthstone's confirmation semantics, and record rejection of Mythic-only confirmation (Legendary also spends the whole bar) and undo (the append-only server ledger cannot retract the spend).
9. Create `spec/pending/2683.md` with one bold §11 paragraph dated 2026-11-01: explain the accidental full-bar spend, summarize the inline confirmation and shared spend hold, say it takes the first number in issue #2683's block, and link `[[R2683000]]`, `[[§14.6]]`, `[[§14.11]]`, `[[R1306002]]`, `[[R2378000]]`, and issue #2683. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

**Tests.**

- `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx` — `R2683000 the first Buy asks in the row, in the reader's language, with Cancel focused, and sends nothing`: proves the localized alert dialog, placement, focus and no first-click POST.
- `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx` — `R2683000 Cancel and Escape spend nothing and return focus to Buy`: proves both cancellation paths, no POST and focus restoration.
- `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx` — `R2683000 Confirm sends exactly one chase purchase, empties the bar, and takes the choice with it`: proves the request body/count and the answer-driven empty-bar UI.
- `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx` — `R2683000 cosmetic Open and chase Buy wait while another spend is out and send nothing`: proves both controls disable, show their wait state, send nothing and re-enable.
- Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/shop/Shop.test.tsx`.
- Run `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`.
- Run `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx`.
- Run `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, and `cargo jackioh patches check`.

**Done when.**

- [ ] First chase Buy sends nothing and shows the localized cosmetic-naming alert dialog with Cancel focused.
- [ ] Cancel and Escape spend nothing and restore focus to the same Buy; Confirm sends exactly one chase purchase and the answered empty bar renders as before.
- [ ] Cosmetic Open and chase Buy disable/wait and send nothing while any same-tab spend is out; their handlers also guard the race before React renders the disabled state.
- [ ] R2683000, its pending provenance, §14.6/§14.11 citations, named tests and `proven_in` agree; no index/fold output is generated.
- [ ] The targeted Shop test, web typecheck, targeted eslint, spec check, rustfmt, catalog check and patches check all pass, with no unrelated diff.

**Risks.**

- A reactive `disabled` prop alone leaves a same-tick race; retain `spendOutNow()` in Open, initial Buy and Confirm paths as well as `useSpendOut()` rendering.
- Clearing the dialog before checking the spend guard can lose the user's pending choice without buying; guard first, then close and send. Keep the server answer as the only source that empties the bar.
- The per-card `chosen` value must be captured exactly as today when Confirm runs; do not move price, eligibility, ownership or bar decisions into the client. No replay, determinism or hidden-information boundary changes.
- Replacing the row can lose focus or create duplicate ids; use one active `asking` id, the component's `useId()`, Cancel `autoFocus`, and remount the original Buy with `autoFocus` only for `asked`.
- The web README's shop and spend-control lists are an app contract; update those two entries with the behavior, while leaving unrelated architecture prose alone.

**Open questions.**

None.
```
